rics.description: Consumer Confidence, Consumer confidence index
rics.meaning: Consumer Confidence Index — official NBS monthly consumer-sentiment gauge. Combines current-conditions and future-expectations sub-indices. Released ~3 weeks after month-end.
rics.how_to_use: Headline ~80-115 historical range. Index dropped sharply post-COVID (April 2022 lockdowns) and remained subdued amid property-sector stress. Cross-check against Westpac MNI Consumer Sentiment (aCNWMCSIR) which uses a different methodology.

rics.description: Consumer Confidence, Consumer expectation index
rics.meaning: Consumer Expectations Index — forward-looking sub-component of CCI. Captures households' 6-month outlook on income, employment, business conditions.
rics.how_to_use: Leads consumption growth by 1-2 quarters. Sharp drops alongside falling current-conditions signal accelerating pessimism. Use spread vs Current Satisfaction (aCNCONCS) for cycle inflection.

rics.description: Consumer Confidence, Consumer satisfaction index
rics.meaning: Consumer Satisfaction Index — current-conditions sub-component of CCI. Captures present economic and household conditions.
rics.how_to_use: Coincides with retail sales activity. Use the spread vs Expectations (aCNCONCE) — when expectations fall faster than satisfaction, cycle is rolling over from peak.

rics.description: International investment position
rics.meaning: China International Investment Position: International investment position. SAFE quarterly statistics on China's external assets/liabilities.
rics.how_to_use: China is a net external creditor (net IIP positive ~$3 trillion). Reserve assets ($3.2T) dominate external assets; FDI liabilities (~$3T) dominate liabilities. Net direct investment position has been deteriorating as outbound FDI slows and inbound FDI weakens.

rics.meaning: Westpac MNI Consumer Sentiment Indicator — alternative private-sector consumer-confidence gauge. Smaller sample but methodology aligned with OECD international standards.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against the official CCI. Useful when official numbers face data-quality questions. Westpac MNI tends to track CCI directionally with some lead at turning points.
